recipes.title: Butter Shrimp Tacos with Creamy Slaw & Sriracha Mayo

items.i: each chili powder, paprika and garlic powder

steps: Toss the cabbage and cilantro with the sour cream, lime juice and a pinch of salt.
Stir the mayo and sriracha together until smooth.
Season the shrimp. Melt the butter in a hot pan and cook the shrimp for 1–2 minutes per side until pink and golden.
Warm the tortillas. Fill with slaw, shrimp and avocado, drizzle with sriracha mayo and finish with cilantro.
